references/typescript-patterns.md:
# TypeScript patterns

Parse untrusted data using the existing schema library, infer its type, then pass the validated value to domain logic. Narrow real discriminated variants exhaustively. Prefer satisfies over unchecked assertions. Preserve simple arrays unless an operation requires a stronger shape. Validate branded IDs only where they prevent a demonstrated mistake.
